ChangeNodeGroup.description_en: Changes the node group of a node

ChangeNodeTypes.description_en: Upgrades or downgrades the specifications of one or more nodes. Before you change the specifications, ensure that the node resources meet the requirements of the target specifications. If a node does not meet the new specification requirements, the task reports success, but the specifications are not changed. Therefore, do not rely on the task status. To confirm a successful change, query the node after the task is complete and check the returned specifications
ChangeNodeTypes.description_zh:
节点规格变配。节点规格变配需要用户保证相关节点资源满足目标规格上限。节点规格是否变配成功，以任务结束后再查询节点返回对应的规格为准， 不能以任务是否成功为准。
在发起规格变配请求之后，如果节点不满足规格要求，任务会成功，但是实际不会变配

RefreshNodeGroupNodes.description_en: Refreshes node group configurations to existing nodes. Manually triggers the node group configuration to take effect on existing nodes. After node group properties are changed, existing nodes do not perform automatic synchronization by default, which causes configuration drift. You can call this operation to refresh node properties. The operation returns an asynchronous refresh task ID, and the result can be queried through DescribeNodeGroupRefreshTask
RefreshNodeGroupNodes.description_zh: 刷新节点组的配置到存量节点：手动触发节点组配置向存量节点生效。节点组属性变更后，存量节点默认不自动同步，存在配置漂移，用户可调用本接口刷新节点属性。接口返回异步刷新任务ID，结果可通过 DescribeNodeGroupRefreshTask 查询
